column1: Since the update I cannot get into the iPhone app at all, the login just spins forever and I have a client demo tomorrow morning.
No crash, just really slow when scrolling the history list on my old Pixel. Not urgent at all.
Would be lovely to have a dark mode in the Android app, my eyes hurt at night. Thanks for the great work!
Tapped subscribe inside the app and got charged twice for premium, my card is now maxed out. Please refund one today.
The app crashes every time I open the camera scanner, so I cannot check in deliveries. Whole team is stuck on this.
Is there any way to export my notes from the mobile app to PDF? Just curious, no rush whatsoever.
Release notes warn about a crash, but nothing crashed for me; instead the notification badge shows 3 when I have zero unread.
push notifs stopped arriving on my android since friday, we rely on them for on-call alerts and missed two incidents
Hi, how do I change the card used for my subscription on the iPad app? Nothing is wrong, just got a new card.
Typo on the onboarding screen, it says Welcom instead of Welcome. Purely cosmetic.
URGENT: my phone was stolen and the app has our payroll data, how do I recover my account and lock it remotely?
Your store listing says $4.99 but the in-app price shows 5.49 for me. Which is right? Not a big deal.
The invoice page shows an amount ten times my plan price and auto-payment runs tomorrow. Please fix before it hits my bank.
The invoice PDF download button is dead and our accountant needs the file for the audit closing today.
Dashboard charts load a bit sluggish in Firefox, though nothing is broken. A workaround is using Chrome, so no hurry.
Could someone resend my receipt from last March? Lost the email, no panic, whenever you get a chance.
Password reset link says expired instantly, every single time. Locked out of the dashboard and the board report is due tomorrow.
Feature idea: let us filter the team page by role. Right now I scroll through 80 names.
I want to downgrade from Business to Starter at renewal, where in settings do I do that?
Still no refund after three weeks of emails. This is my rent money and I need it back immediately.
Billing page header overlaps the logo on a narrow laptop window, purely cosmetic.
Loving the new analytics tab! Compliments to the team, would recommend it to colleagues.
Our whole team gets a 502 Bad Gateway on the dashboard since 9am, nobody can see orders. Please advise!
dashbord exports CSV with semicolons instead of commas, i can fix it in excel but figured u should know
POST /v2/orders returns 500 for any payload since the deploy, production checkout is down for our shop.
Webhook retries arrive out of order sometimes. We dedupe on our side so it is not blocking anything.
We got an overage charge of 2k for API calls our logs say never happened. Please reverse it, the card is billed tomorrow.
Does the Python SDK support async natively or should we wrap it with threads? Planning for next quarter.
Docs promise 100 req/min but I get a 429 at roughly 50 in the test environment. Which number is right? Nothing urgent.
Token refresh endpoint rejects valid refresh tokens, so all mobile clients of ours are logged out in a loop.
What is the price for the enterprise rate limit tier? Our usage will triple in spring. Just budgeting.
Request: please add cursor pagination to the /users listing. Offset gets painful with 2M rows.
Quick question, is the v1 API being switched off tomorrow? We have not migrated and the docs email was vague.
We run a small agency and would like to discuss a reseller partnership. Who is the right contact?
Your support replies are always friendly and fast. Just wanted to say thank you!
Do you offer a student or nonprofit discount? Our club has no budget but would love to use the tools.
